clue.text: Having for sale item put up for the present time

definitions.meaning: a shop ... goods has them on its shelves to sell

definitions.text: item put up for the present time
definitions.meaning: the ... hung up at Christmas, present time, to be filled with gifts

explanation.definitionFit: A shop that carries an item keeps it in stock; the Christmas sock hung by the fireplace holds presents.

clue.text: Quake in the centre, more or less

indicators.note: in the means the answer lies inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: An earthquake felt roughly at the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremor is a shaking of the ground, a small earthquake.

clue.text: Company about to broadcast somewhere in Egypt

indicators.note: about means going round, so company encloses the other piece

parts.note: to air a programme is to broadcast it

explanation.surface: A firm is set to transmit from a spot in Egypt.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital city of Egypt is a place in that country.

clue.text: Result of a big blow to the economy?

definitions.text: Result of a big blow to the economy?

parts.words: Result of a big blow to the economy?
parts.note: blowing into a balloon expands it; a rise in prices swells the economy's money figures

explanation.definitionFit: Blowing up a balloon is this, and so is a general rise in prices.

clue.text: Canal boat almost departed with wrong load

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is missing from the word for departed

parts.note: gone means departed

indicators.note: wrong means the letters of load are set out incorrectly

explanation.surface: A Venetian boat nearly leaving with its cargo badly stowed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims GONE to GON; 'wrong' rearranges LOAD to DOLA.
explanation.definitionFit: The gondola is the boat of the Venice canals.

clue.text: Unveil the ultimate sex-op surgery

indicators.note: surgery cuts up and rearranges, so the letters of sex-op are reordered
ultimate means the final letter of the word the

explanation.surface: A call to reveal the full story of a sex-change operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surgery' rearranges SEXOP to EXPOS; 'the ultimate' adds E, the last letter of 'the'.
explanation.definitionFit: To expose something is to uncover it, a close synonym of unveil.

clue.text: Not a hit certainly, but he plays his part

definitions.meaning: in cricket a run not scored off the bat, such as a wide or bye
a film walk-on actor with a small role

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a cricket run not struck by the batter and a non-speaking film background actor.

clue.text: Favouring lightweight in list of bouts

parts.note: pro means in favour of
a gramme is a very light unit of weight

explanation.surface: Backing a lightweight boxer on a fight card.
explanation.definitionFit: A fight bill lists the order of events, as any schedule of items does.

clue.text: Painless exercising for dogs

indicators.note: exercising puts things through their paces, here moving the letters around

explanation.surface: Gentle exercise suits our pet dogs.
explanation.definitionFit: Spaniels are a family of breeds of dog.

clue.text: Opinion to contradict loudly

parts.note: to belie a claim is to show it false, to contradict it
F, forte, is the musical direction for loudly

explanation.surface: Someone is told to argue noisily against a view.
explanation.definitionFit: A belief is a view one holds, a synonym of opinion.

clue.text: A race of more than local interest

definitions.meaning: the Grand ..., Britain's famous steeplechase run at Aintree, often just called the ...
something that matters across the whole country rather than one area

explanation.definitionFit: The Grand National horse race is known simply by this name; the adjective means nationwide in scope.

clue.text: Spot of colour trouble in America

parts.note: spelt the American way without the U, as 'in America' signals
ado is fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: A dash of paint causes a problem in the United States.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in America' does double service on the surface but the wordplay needs it for the US spelling COLOR; the definition is 'Spot', a place, here a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: A spot is a place, and this is a place in the USA, a western state.

clue.text: On winding road it's showing skill

indicators.note: a winding road twists, so its letters are twisted into a new order

parts.note: the word it, with the 's standing for 'is' as a link

explanation.surface: On a twisting road a driver demonstrates their ability.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' is only a link here; the surface makes it sound like the driver's position on the road.
explanation.definitionFit: Being adroit means being deft, so it is a matter of displaying dexterity.

clue.text: It's the done thing in France

definitions.text: It's the done thing in France

parts.words: It's the done thing in France
parts.note: not etiquette but the French phrase for something already done and irreversible

explanation.definitionFit: The French expression means an accomplished fact, literally a thing that has been done.

clue.text: Yet it's likely to be a slender hope

definitions.text: Yet it's likely to be a slender hope

parts.words: Yet it's likely to be a slender hope
parts.note: the joke is that something called fat is in fact slim; the expression ironically means hardly any prospect

explanation.definitionFit: The ironic phrase means very little likelihood, so a thin hope.

clue.text: It needs a good wind before it moves

definitions.text: It needs a good wind before it moves

parts.words: It needs a good wind before it moves
parts.note: not a sailing ship waiting for a breeze but a mechanism powered by a wound spring

explanation.definitionFit: Spring-driven machinery must be wound up before it will run.

clue.text: Made fish pie for the hungry

indicators.note: pie in printing means type jumbled up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A cook baked a fish pie to feed the starving.
explanation.definitionFit: Famished means extremely hungry, starving.

clue.text: Bound, but also not bound, to be unreliable

parts.note: fast means firmly fixed or tied, as in held fast
and means also, in addition
loose means untied, free

explanation.surface: A paradox: something both tied and untied cannot be trusted.
explanation.walkthrough: To play fast and loose is to behave unreliably, so the phrase serves as an adjective here; 'but' and 'to be' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes inconsistent, untrustworthy conduct, hence undependable.

clue.text: Beat a doctor in final

indicators.note: in means placed inside the word for final

parts.note: last means final
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: Someone thrashes a doctor in a championship decider.
explanation.definitionFit: To lambast is to thrash or attack, so to beat.

clue.text: State one is found in after very good neighbourly party

parts.note: so as a word of approval, as in 'so good'

indicators.note: is found in means one piece sits inside another

parts.note: Cal is short for California
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A country's ideal citizen joins a friendly political group.
explanation.definitionFit: A social is an informal gathering, often for neighbours.

clue.text: Accompanying a student, nevertheless

parts.note: with means together with, accompanying
L, for learner, is the plate a British learner driver displays

explanation.surface: Someone goes along with a pupil, despite everything.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned adverb meaning all the same, notwithstanding.

clue.text: Rubber solution from past times

parts.note: late means past, former
X is the multiplication sign, times

explanation.surface: A rubbery liquid made from earlier ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Latex is the milky fluid from which rubber is made.

clue.text: Right to succeed

definitions.meaning: used as a verb, to put a wrong right or compensate
to prosper and do well in life

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to repair damage and to rise to prosperity.

clue.text: Make progress in friendly relations

definitions.meaning: to advance, as in getting on in a career
to be on good terms with someone

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to advance and to be on good terms.

clue.text: What may be served in porcelain at meal-time

parts.note: china is fine porcelain crockery
tea is a meal and the time for it in Britain

explanation.surface: A suggestion of what might come in fine crockery at teatime.
explanation.definitionFit: A beverage of leaves from that country is a drink offered to guests.

clue.text: Kiss in love story said to make a neat ending

indicators.note: the kiss is placed inside the rest of the wordplay

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

indicators.note: said means the word is spoken, so a word sounding like it is used

parts.note: a tale is a story
X is the kiss written at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: A romantic tale with a kiss delivers a tidy conclusion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neat' is an old word for cattle, so 'a neat ending' is the tail of an ox, not a tidy finish.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat means cattle in old usage, so the tail end of a bullock fits.

clue.text: Farewell words to the French about to meet death

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: aux is French for to the (plural)
to die is to meet one's death

explanation.surface: Goodbyes said in French to those facing their end.
explanation.definitionFit: These French goodbyes, plural, are parting words.

clue.text: Resented becoming unwell?

definitions.meaning: to have taken something ill is to have been offended by it

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both having resented something and having fallen sick.
